synthesis.evidence_balance: mixed — genuine scale/EBITDA-inflection and constructive targets sit directly against ongoing cash burn, sub decline and a sharp consensus cut.

bull_points.claim: The equity has de-rated ~66% over 180 days against a +17% small-cap benchmark, an almost entirely idiosyncratic drawdown that sets up an overshoot-vs-terminal question rather than a market beta problem.
The Hulu + Live TV combination materially expanded scale — pro forma trailing-12-month revenue of ~$6.2 billion with 6.2 million North America subscribers — versus a market cap of only $256M.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: FuboTV Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, Feb 03, 2026.rtf

bull_points.claim: Trailing-12-month pro forma adjusted EBITDA has now exceeded $100 million, a management-stated milestone framed against a long-term target of at least $300 million by 2028.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: FuboTV Inc., Q2 2026 Earnings Call, May 06, 2026.rtf

bull_points.claim: Consensus forward EBITDA anchors are substantial and rising into FY27 — FY26E $92.3M and FY27E $187.1M — against a simple TEV of $426.8M.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Estimates→Trends (FY26/FY27 consensus EBITDA, latest snapshot)

bull_points.claim: Absolute revenue has grown continuously (3,419→3,846→4,220→4,413→5,304 LTM) and gross margin turned positive to 4% LTM — the margin % is rising off the reclassified base, not deteriorating, so a low headline margin is not the real signal here.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

bull_points.claim: Revenue growth of 22% far exceeds the peer-median 9%, a genuine growth advantage that argues the TEV/Rev discount (name 0.4 vs peer median 1.9) may be residual rather than fully earned — the human must judge justified-vs-residual against the heterogeneous roster.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Operating Statistics (name vs peer median: growth/margin/leverage/beta)

bull_points.claim: The commercial structure gives contracted visibility: Fubo receives a wholesale fee at 95% of Hulu + Live TV carriage costs in 2026 scaling to 99% by 2028, a step-up management cites as underpinning the EBITDA-expansion path.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: FuboTV Inc., Q2 2026 Earnings Call, May 06, 2026.rtf

bull_points.claim: Sell-side posture is constructive — consensus rating Buy (1.00) with a mean/median target of $17.00, well above the stale $9.56 last close.
Management states it navigated the NBCU loss with minimal incremental combined-company churn, evidencing that the business is not reliant on any single programming provider.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: FuboTV Inc., Q2 2026 Earnings Call, May 06, 2026.rtf

bear_points.claim: The company is FCF-negative (LTM levered FCF −$131.2M) and burning cash with net debt $170M and no derived cash-runway — a genuine survival risk, not an optical metric.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Cash Flow 'Levered Free Cash Flow' [LTM 12 months Mar-31-2026]

bear_points.claim: Consensus FY26 EBITDA has been cut ~34% over six months (140.7 → 92.3), and GAAP EPS, EBIT, EBT and net income all crossed from positive to negative on the same path — a broad, worsening estimate deterioration.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Estimates→Trends (current-FY consensus path; ragged, absent lookbacks n/a)

bear_points.claim: The drawdown was driven by discrete earnings gap-downs (2026-02-03 and 2026-05-06, both Item 2.02 results filings), tying the ~66% decline to fundamentals reported at results, not to sentiment.
bear_points.source_ref: EDGAR 8-K item codes at the gap-down dates (not blanket-labelled earnings)

bear_points.claim: The name's forward EBITDA multiple is NOT cheap on the metric that reconciles the optical TEV/Rev discount: NTM TEV/EBITDA is 17.77 vs a peer median of 8.19 — a forward premium, meaning the cheap-on-revenue read is not the real signal.

bear_points.claim: Return on capital remains negative across every reported period (RoCE -11.2% → -3.3% LTM), so the business has not yet earned its cost of capital despite improvement.

bear_points.claim: Share count is diluting (+4.0% over ~1 year) and management announced a reverse stock split, adding to per-share pressure on holders.
Loss of NBCUniversal content and a decision to lower prices to preserve consumer value point to real revenue/mix pressure from a distribution dispute the company could not resolve.

key_unknowns: Cash runway is not derivable: no CIQ Net Debt/EBITDA, no interest-coverage row, and cash not derived — an expected-disclosure gap that is a bearish risk given ongoing FCF burn.
No segment or geographic EBITDA breakout (single Streaming segment, single US geography) and no segment-EBITDA section — opacity on where profitability actually sits.
Covenant terms UNKNOWN (extraction failed; no CIK-scoped agreement exhibit located) — leverage-trigger risk on $323M senior bonds plus leases cannot be assessed.
TEV as-of (2026-06-24) and multiple-pricing vintage (2026-06-12) are incoherent (derived FY26 $17.4M vs direct $92.3M, residual 0.812) — comps should be re-pulled before leaning on any multiple.
Price is stale at assembly (last close 2026-07-08, $9.56, 15 days old) — the actual de-rating and any implied gap to the $17 target may differ.
The peer set is HETEROGENEOUS (caps $478M–$306.6B, 642x; the name $256M) — every peer stat is confidence-gated, not a clean benchmark.
FY26 EBITDA guidance is stale (dated 2026-05-06, 61 days old) with no delivery track-record — the credibility of the $80–100M guide against a worsening consensus path is unresolved.
Whether the Disney ad-server CPM/fill-rate uplift is material enough to offset sub attrition and price cuts — management asserts early benefit but no validated figures exist.
